paper.title_en: A more general exact solution for the Schwarzschild black hole in a Bertotti-Robinson-Bonnor-Melvin universe
paper.abstract_en: We begin by introducing a new parameterization for the Ovcharenko-Podolský family of exact solutions of the Einstein-Maxwell equations describing uncharged and non-accelerating static black holes immersed in an external Bertotti-Robinson electromagnetic field. The new spacetime is, in general, different from the original Ovcharenko-Podolský one, in particular on the branches solving the field equations, for which the original parameterization can lead to black holes with a negative mass, whereas the new one always leads to black holes with a positive mass. Moreover, by introducing additional gauge constants, we remove the various pathologies and ensure consistency with the laws of black hole thermodynamics. We then obtain a new family of Einstein-Maxwell solutions by generalizing this new parameterization, through Harrison transformation within the Ernst method, to also include an external electromagnetic field of the Bonnor-Melvin type. We again identify the appropriate gauge constants required to remove the possible pathologies and ensure that the resulting solutions satisfy the laws of black hole thermodynamics. Finally, we investigate the vacuum subcase of the new family and establish its relation to previously known metrics.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文引入了一个新的精确解族，涵盖外部电磁场中的黑洞，并明确验证了黑洞热力学定律，这对于该子领域具有重要意义。
decision.title_zh: 一个更一般的精确解：在Bertotti-Robinson-Bonnor-Melvin宇宙中的Schwarzschild黑洞
decision.abstract_zh: 我们首先为描述浸入外部Bertotti-Robinson电磁场中的不带电和非加速静态黑洞的Ovcharenko-Podolský爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦方程组精确解族引入一种新的参数化。新的时空通常与原始的Ovcharenko-Podolský不同，特别是在求解场方程的分支上，原始参数化可能导致负质量的黑洞，而新的参数化总是导致正质量的黑洞。此外，通过引入额外的规范常数，我们消除了各种病态，并确保与黑洞热力学定律的一致性。然后，我们通过将这种新参数化进行推广，通过Ernst方法中的Harrison变换，也包括Bonnor-Melvin型外部电磁场，获得了一个新的爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦解族。我们再次识别出必要的规范常数，以消除可能的病态，并确保所得解满足黑洞热力学定律。最后，我们研究了新族的真空子情形，并建立了它与已知度规的关系。
